title: LearnUP Standard API Error Model
description: Structured error details model returned for all 4xx and 5xx API failures.

examples: The requested resource could not be found.

details.description: Optional list of field-level validation errors or specific issue details.

field.description: The payload field, query parameter, or header that caused the error.

issue.description: Detailed explanation of the validation failure or requirement.
examples: Must be a valid enterprise email address.

correlationId.description: Unique trace correlation identifier associated with the request.
